thread:
alex_infra: Julien at Zenith DM'd — partial RMA + network segment change in FRA blocking h100 staging for eu-west-1 pool. Need procurement ETA and whether insurance covers split shipment.

sam_procure: @julien_vendor can you confirm lead time if we split air vs sea and incremental cost? finance needs numbers.

julien_vendor: short answer: we can split. Options: air for urgent 8 units (ETA 3 days) + sea for remainder 22 units (ETA ~18 days). Air uplift ~€28k, sea no uplift. AWB for air: FRAWB99887766.

maya_ops: If only 8 arrive, can we bring 2 racks online for a canary? Need thermal/power check confirmations.

alex_infra: 8 units ≈ 2 racks usable for canary but reduces burst capacity. We'll shift some Dedicated capacity from onprem. Netseg change: staging VLAN -> 10.42.8.0/24 — ops needs firewall + routing updates.

sam_procure: Who pays air uplift? Vendor quote lists incoterm DDP but not explicit on split RMA. Can Zenith absorb part?

julien_vendor: We can absorb 50% of uplift if split is due to customs hold or depot DOA. If customer requests expedite w/out DOA, uplift billed to buyer. Customs flagged docs for 2 units — may justify partial absorb.

maya_ops: opsbot create ticket for netseg change + firewall request, tag infra and security. Also need exact serials for the 8 air units so depot can pre-provision keys.

opsbot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-1883. Assigned to maya_ops and alex_infra. ETA for firewall change: 4 hours.

julien_vendor: Serials for air batch: SN-H100-8231, SN-H100-8232, SN-H100-8233, SN-H100-8234, SN-H100-8235, SN-H100-8236, SN-H100-8237, SN-H100-8238. I'll push docs to shared drive and email AWB manifest.

alex_infra: Two action items: 1) sam to confirm cost approval by EOD for air uplift (use emergency dev budget), 2) maya to update firewall & staging VLAN and pre-provision KMS with serials.

sam_procure: Finance ok to cover up to €20k — need PO amendment for remaining ~€8k unless vendor covers. Julien, confirm acceptance of 50% absorb ASAP.

julien_vendor: Confirm Zenith will absorb €4k now (we'll invoice €4k after shipment). Remaining billed to Redwood. Amended commercial note incoming.

maya_ops: Starting firewall change. @alex_infra do we need temporary fallback routing to avoid degraded paths during staging?

alex_infra: Yes. Set temporary route to AMS edge via rt-ams-egress-2 for the staging VLAN until vendor confirms final ASN peering. <1 hour cutover.

opsbot: Deploy job queued: netseg-change-staging-1746. Estimated window 30m.

sam_procure: Once PO updated, I'll authorize payment. Cost center: infra-priority.

julien_vendor: Shipping manifest pushed, air picked up tonight. Will post proof of pickup and ETA slot. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

maya_ops: Noted. I'll pre-provision keys for listed serials and prepare canary checklist (minimal regen test only).

alex_infra: Keep updates short. Escalate if customs reappears.

julien_vendor: Will update if any AWB changes or customs flags.

opsbot: INC-2026-1883 updated: air manifest uploaded, firewall job started. last update 1746129540.
